title: Well-reasoned mandate plan (SSO for an audit finding)
brain_dump: Our internal admin console still uses local username/password accounts. The SOC 2 audit flagged it as finding AF-7 and we must remediate by Nov 30. Plan: put the console behind Okta SSO using SAML (it's our company standard), provision and deprovision accounts with SCIM so leavers lose access within 24h, keep one vaulted break-glass local admin with alerting on use, and disable all other local passwords. About 40 ops engineers use the console. Decided; I mainly want this captured cleanly with tasks.
